title: Restore the blank localhost app
summary: Restarted the stalled Expo server with a cleared Metro cache; the real sign-in screen now renders on localhost:8081.

changes.detail: Recovered the local development process that served HTML but never delivered its JavaScript bundle. Restarted the existing development workflow on port 8081 with --clear.
The existing startup workflow regenerated the offline car runtime and started the local learning API. No source logic was changed.

validation.name: Actual browser rendering
validation.detail: Fresh headless Edge loaded localhost:8081, displayed the real email sign-in form, and produced a visually reviewed screenshot. No fixture authentication was used.

validation.name: Startup
validation.detail: Owner authentication configuration and session database check passed; local API started at 127.0.0.1:3002; Metro completed the web bundle.

validation.name: Limits
validation.detail: No credentials submitted, authenticated session or physical-device checks performed. No deployment. Local server must remain running.
